Cheap land close to urban areas could be useful for siting data centers, as they benefit from being close to critical infrastructure. • Water availability seems to be very low on the importance list. Risks of hazard and construction costs are more important (this could be due to the quality of data used/representation of water use in the model). *Feature importance does not necessarily reverse-engineer the real-life decision markers; it ranks features highly if they improve the model’s discriminative National Laboratory of the Rockies | 21 ability. Collinearity may also influence the relative importance of features.
